title: sutra_help with recipes
description:
## Parent

sutra/v1/5 — PRD: sutra v1 review intelligence engine

## What to build

Add `sutra_help` MCP tool returning agent-oriented recipes for common workflows. Topics: quickstart, workspaces, review, query, freshness, conventions, troubleshooting, recipes. Recipes should reference `sutra_review` and existing tools with concrete examples.

Key recipes:
- "review my current diff"
- "find callers and affected tests for this function"
- "explain why a result is stale"
- "check whether this change violates local conventions"
- "trace a path between two symbols"

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `sutra_help` MCP tool registered and callable
- [ ] `sutra_help(topic)` returns focused content for the given topic
- [ ] `sutra_help()` with no args returns topic list with one-line summaries
- [ ] At least 5 recipes with concrete tool invocation examples
- [ ] Recipes reference sutra_review and existing tools accurately

## Blocked by

- sutra/v1/13 — sutra_review: structural core (so recipes can reference it)

messages.author: agent
messages.text: Implementation complete. sutra_help MCP tool added with 8 topics (quickstart, workspaces, review, query, freshness, conventions, troubleshooting, recipes). 5+ recipes with concrete tool invocation examples. All 6 help tests + 27 contract tests pass.
